verdict.rationale: In-tool team chat is a fair question for a work-planning tool like Jira, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no native chat, messaging or threaded discussion inside Jira. The Slack integration and automation items only connect an external chat tool to Jira workflows, which is an adjacent integration rather than chatting inside Jira itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in
